verses.text: Ixlajwi chi', ix sk'anb'an winhaj David t'a Jehová icha tik: --¿Tom syal in k'exk'och t'a yol junok chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh: --Syala', xchi. Ix sk'anb'anpax winh: --¿Mach junok chonhab' b'aj syal in k'ochi? xchi winh. --Ha t'a chonhab' Hebrón syal a k'ochi, xchi Jehová chi'.
Yuj chi', ata' ix b'at winhaj David chi' yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum schawanhil, haton ix Ahinoam aj Jezreel yet' ix Abigail yetb'eyumkan winhaj xilb'a Nabal, aj Carmel.
Ix yik'anpaxb'at heb' winh ayek' yet' winh yet' yetb'eyum junjun heb' yet' yal yuninal heb'. Ix kajnaj heb' t'a Hebrón yet' t'a yaldeail.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och heb' yichamtak winakil yinhtilal Judá t'a winhaj David chi', ix yak'ankanoch winh heb' sreyalok. Ix yab'an winhaj David to a heb' aj Jabes t'a yol yik Galaad ix mukan winhaj Saúl,
yuj chi' ix yak'b'at juntzanh heb' schekab' winh, yik b'at yal heb' t'a heb' icha tik: Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'ayex yuj tastak wach' ix he k'ulej yujto ix he muk winhaj Saúl ko reyal.
Ha tiknaik aokab' Jehová tz'ok' sk'ool t'ayex, tzex xajanani, anhejtona' pax in a in tik, wach' ol wutej in b'a t'ayex yuj tas ix he k'ulej chi'.
Yuj chi', aq'ek eyip, tek'an tzeyutej he b'a, wach'chom ix cham winhaj Saúl ko reyal chi', palta a masanil heb' yinhtilal Judá ix in ak'anoch sreyalok, xchib'at winhaj David chi'.
Axo ix aji, a winhaj Abner yuninal winhaj Ner, yajalil masanil heb' soldado winhaj Saúl, a winh ix ik'anb'at winhaj Is-boset yuninal winhaj Saúl chi' t'a Mahanaim.
Ata' ix yak'kanoch winh sreyalok juntzanh chonhab' tik: Haton Galaad, Gesuri, Jezreel, Efraín, Benjamín yet' juntzanhxo chonhab' yik Israel.

Ha winhaj Is-boset chi', 40 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal t'a chonhab' Israel chi', chab' ab'il ix yak' reyal chi' winh, palta haxo heb' yinhtilal Judá, a winhaj David ayxo och sreyalok heb'.
Nanhal swajxakil ab'il ix yak' reyal winhaj David chi' t'a heb' yinhtilal Judá t'a chonhab' Hebrón.
Icha tik ix aj yoch owal. Ha winhaj Abner chi', ix el winh t'a Mahanaim, ix b'atkan winh t'a Gabaón yet' heb' soldado yik winhaj Is-boset.

Axo winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarvia, ix el winh yet' heb' soldado winhaj David t'a Hebrón, ix schalaj sb'a winh yet' winhaj Abner b'aj smolb'ej sb'a ha ha' t'a yik Gabaón. Ha chab' makan heb' soldado chi', ix k'och heb' t'a ha ha' chi', junjun makan heb' ix kan t'a junjun sk'axepal ha'.
Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Abner t'a winhaj Joab chi' icha tik: --Elokab'kot jaywanhok heb' winh kelemtak yak' owal t'a kichanh tik, xchi winh. --Ichokab'ta', xchi winhaj Joab chi'.

Yuj chi' ix elta heb' winh, lajannhej sb'isul yik junjun heb' winh ix elta, lajchawanh heb' winh t'a yinhtilal Benjamín ayoch yet' winhaj Is-boset chi', lajchawanh pax heb' winh yik winhaj David chi' ix elta.

Junjun heb' winh ix syam sjolom heb' yajk'ol heb' winh chi', ix stiplanoch k'een yespada heb' winh t'a skostil junjun, yuj chi' junnhej ix aj scham heb' winh smasanil. Yuj chi' “Teklajb'ail” ix sb'iejkan jun lugar chi', ha t'a yol yik Gabaón chi' ay.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', te niwan ix aj yoch owal yuj heb' winh. Ix ak'ji ganar winhaj Abner yet' heb' soldado yuj heb' soldado winhaj David chi'.
Ata' ayoch oxwanh heb' winh yune' ix Sarvia, haton winhaj Joab, winhaj Abisai yet' winhaj Asael. Ha winhaj Asael chi' te jelan sb'ey winh icha nok' k'ultakil chej.
Ix och jinhan winh t'a spatik winhaj Abner, majxo yal-laj yel winhaj Abner chi'.
Ayik ix yilanb'at winh t'a spatik, ix yalan winh: --Mato a ach Asael ach chi', xchi winh. --Ha in toni, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Abner chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Aktej in a pechani, aokab' junok heb' winh kelem tik tza yama', tzik'ankan masanil tastak yet'nak, xchi winh t'a winh. Palta haxo winhaj Asael chi' jun, maj yal-laj sk'ol winh syaktej spechan winh.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Abner chi' t'a winh junelxo: --Aktej in a pechani, ¿mato tzin ak' wal pural yik tzach in milanchamok? Tato icha chi', ¿tas ol aj in sat in k'och t'a yichanh winh uk'tak aj Joab? xchi winh.

Palta a winhaj Asael chi', maj yaktej winh spechan winh, yuj chi' haxo yok slanza winhaj Abner chi' ix stipkot t'a spatik, a wal t'a sk'ool winhaj Asael chi' ix ochi, ix k'axpajelk'och te' t'a yich spatik winh. Ix telwi winh, ix cham winh. Masanil mach sk'och t'a jun lugar b'aj ix cham winh chi' tz'och wan heb' yila'.

Axo winhaj Joab yet' winhaj Abisai ix b'atnhej heb' winh t'a spatik winhaj Abner chi'. Ayik wanxo yem k'u, ix k'och heb' winh t'a sjolom lum witz Amma, ay t'a yichanh Gía, haton b'aj sb'atkan sb'eal juntzanh tzinan lu'um t'a Gabaón.
Ata' ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' yinhtilal Benjamín yet' winhaj Abner chi', junxonhej ix yutej sb'a heb' smasanil t'a jun tzalan.

Axo winhaj Abner chi' ix awaj t'a winhaj Joab icha tik: --¿Tom manh ol aktej a milancham anima tik? ¿Tom max a na' jab'ok to anhej chukal syik'kot jun tik t'a kib'anh? ¿Janik' ol al t'a heb' a soldado to tz'och waan heb' spechan heb' yetchonhab'? xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Joab chi' icha tik: --Syil wal Dios, q'uinalok maj ach awajok, ix am onh b'atnhej t'a he patik masanto t'a q'uinhib'alil k'ik'an, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Joab chi' to spuji nok' ch'aak, yuj chi' ix och waan masanil heb' soldado yik winhaj David spechan heb' yik Israel chi'.
Axo winhaj Abner chi' yet' heb' soldado pilan ak'wal ix b'ey heb' t'a spanhanil Arabá, ix k'axpajek' heb' t'a ha' Jordán yet' t'a yol yik Bitrón masanto ix k'och heb' t'a Mahanaim.

Axo pax winhaj Joab chi', ix och waan winh spechan winhaj Abner chi'. Ichato chi' ix smolb'an heb' soldado winh smasanil, ix yawtan slistail heb' winh, haxo ix aji to ay 19 heb' soldado yik winhaj David chi' ix chami, ix champax winhaj Asael.
Palta haxo heb' soldado yik Benjamín yet'nak winhaj Abner, 360 heb' ix cham yuj heb' soldado yik winhaj David chi'.

Ha winhaj Joab yet' masanil heb' soldado, pilan ak'wal ix b'ey heb', ayxoek' heb' t'a Hebrón ix q'uinhib'i. Ayik wan smeltzaj heb', ix ek' heb' yik' sniwanil winhaj Asael chi'. Ha b'aj mukan smam winh t'a chonhab' Belén, ata' ix mukji winh.
